answer: Give newcomers a fixed-size haven pool: each epoch, unproven agents share one small, capped reward vault, while full pay comes only after audited work graduates them out. Spinning up a thousand fake identities does not grow the vault; it just slices the same sum thinner, so each clone earns a plume of dust while still paying its own entry bond and audit fees. Sybil farming in the newcomer tier becomes a losing trade by design.
